messages:
Sam Carter: Heads up — Sprocket Health wants a short APAC pilot tomorrow 09:00-17:00 PT. They asked for a temporary egress allowlist + a soft QPS bump. Can ops/neteng confirm feasibility and window?
Sprocket Health (customer): Quick details — we'd like a 2k QPS burst window (sustained ~800 qps) and these CIDRs added to the egress allowlist: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.64/26. Traffic will originate from tokyo region.
Maya Rao: Got it. Can you confirm timeframe in UTC so we can schedule the revoke?
Sprocket Health (customer): 09:00-17:00 PT -> 16:00-00:00 UTC for tomorrow.
Ivy Chen (CS): FYI renewal touchpoint next week — account health is 'watch'. If the pilot is smooth I'll mark renewal risk as low. Also collecting enablement feedback to include in the post-pilot recap.
Noah Patel: Neteng / ops — proposed temporary config below, please apply to route `prod-sprocket` and set autorevoke.
Noah Patel: ```yaml
route: prod-sprocket
qps: 2000
window_hours: 8
allowlist:
  - 203.0.113.0/24
  - 198.51.100.64/26
autorevoke: "2024-10-05T00:00Z"
```
ops-bot: Created config PR #4821 for temporary rate window and allowlist. https://git.company/pr/4821 :white_check_mark:
NetEng: CIDRs added to staging and QPS bump applied to staging route. Rolling to prod in ~5m; monitoring for 429s and token errors.
Ivy Chen (CS): Thanks — I'll send Sprocket Health a confirmation + a short checklist (test tokens, peak ramp plan, rollback steps). @Sam Carter please keep an eye on cost delta; @Maya Rao can you schedule a 15-min post-pilot debrief tomorrow?
Sprocket Health (customer): :thumbsup: We'll fire test traffic at 15:50 UTC and start full ramp at 16:00 UTC. Will report any anomalies here.
